content: Deterministic sim separated from presentation: record inputs, delta times and seeds; simulate everything else. Entitas-CSharp and Photon Quantum put all core game code in a pure C# assembly with unit tests, Unity is a view. Event sourcing makes replay deterministic by recording non-deterministic responses (LLM/tool/player) into the log rather than assuming reproducibility. Matches Helios Docs/Architecture.md command-sourcing model.
